name: AAA-Bench
description: A benchmark for whether vision-language models decide correctly to answer, ask for clarification or abstain when a COCO image under-specifies a question. Items come in counterfactual pairs that share the question wording but need different actions, and every gold action is derived from COCO instance annotations. 7,400 items in 3,700 pairs over 59 categories; train 4,994, validation 956, test 1,450.
citeAs: @inproceedings{sumit2027aaabench, title={{AAA-Bench}: Counterfactual, Verifier-Grounded Evaluation of Vision-Language Models as Decision-Makers Under Visual Ambiguity}, author={Sumit, Shahriar Shakir and Tahtali, Murat and Mirjalili, Seyedali}, booktitle={Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV)}, year={2027}}
rai:dataCollection: Gold actions are derived from COCO 2017 instance annotations with stated rules; questions come from three templates per family. Three annotators from the research team audited the rules on a 400-item sample (Fleiss' kappa 0.833), which led to one rule being changed and one retired.
rai:dataLimitations: COCO scenes and object-instance ambiguity only. The direct_answer field is a construction by-product and is not a reference answer. Human agreement with the derived labels is moderate on the boundary between one dominant and several comparable instances and on crowds. One test pair uses the same image twice.
rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating and developing answer/ask/abstain decision policies for vision-language models.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None collected. COCO images can show people; they are not redistributed.

distribution.name: jsonl-files
distribution.description: The three splits, one JSON object per line.

recordSet.name: items
recordSet.description: One AAA-Bench item per record. data/schema.json documents the nested fields (visual_evidence, valid_interpretations, clarifications).

field.name: image_path
field.description: Path of the image inside a COCO 2017 folder, e.g. train2017/000000384993.jpg.

field.name: question
field.description: The question. Both members of a pair have exactly the same question.

field.name: coco_category_ids
field.description: The COCO category the question asks about.

field.name: num_objects_in_scene
field.description: Number of COCO instance annotations in the image, over all categories.

field.name: decision_basis
field.description: The scene configuration that determines the gold action (see aaa_bench/construction.py).

field.name: is_ambiguous
field.description: True when gold_action is ask or abstain.

field.name: ambiguity_type
field.description: referential for ask items, resolution for crowd items, null otherwise (absent-object items included).

field.name: difficulty
field.description: Set by the construction: 1 for one clear referent, present, absent and countable items, 2 for one dominant referent, 3 for ask and crowd items. Not a measured difficulty.

field.name: direct_answer
field.description: Answer text from the construction, not used by any metric. Spatial answer items: the side of the referent (left, center or right). Countable items: the number of referents, which undercounts when instances are small. Present items: yes. Absent items: no, the answer of the rule the human study replaced. Colour answer items: the placeholder yes, since COCO has no colour labels. Null for ask and crowd items.

field.name: pair_id
field.description: Id of the counterfactual pair; each pair has exactly two items with different gold actions.
